reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended The narrow fix aligns streaming with existing non-streaming behavior and includes targeted regression coverage. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Preserves redacted reasoning blocks in Bedrock Converse streaming telemetry, matching non-streaming behavior. **Changes:** - Records redacted reasoning deltas as empty reasoning parts. - Adds a regression test and changelog entry. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-bedrock/​tests/​test_converse_stream.py | Tests preservation of redacted reasoning. | | instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-bedrock/​src/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​genai/​bedrock/​stream.py | Handles redacted reasoning deltas. | | instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-bedrock/​.changelog/​932.fixed | Documents the fix. |
Review effort: Balanced

What's the point of recording "" instead of redacted content?

I think this needs discussion / documentation in https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai to decide if/how to record redacted content and for now dropping it does not seem too different from having empty string.

review_comments.body:
nit: the streamed path never recorded the empty part on main, so only the non-streamed behavior changes for users.

```suggestion
Stop recording an empty reasoning part for redacted Converse reasoning content.
```
